rule: this file is never edited in place. changing a definition means writing a new file with a new registration_id and a new frozen_utc. the hash of this file is stamped on every leaderboard row, so a score can always be traced to the definition that produced it.

corpus.source: nflverse pinned dataset via nfl-line-audit/data/corpus_games.csv, third-party, reconciled 14/14 for Week 10 2026 against the official finals
corpus.protocol: walk-forward only: the ratings used for a game are fitted on every game strictly before that game's week, including earlier weeks of the same season. no game is ever scored by a model that saw it.

markets_in_order.why: the line is the market's own point prediction; take the line and you are 50/50 by construction
the moneyline is a two-way price, so its benchmark is the price without the book's margin

gates.name: pre-registration
gates.rule: a strategy may not be scored unless its definition was committed before the first settled bet
gates.passes: fixed id + hash on the row

gates.name: walk-forward
gates.rule: no bet may be priced from a fit that saw its own game

gates.name: proper score
gates.rule: rank on Brier skill against the stated benchmark, never on return
gates.passes: skill > 0 with a clustered interval excluding 0

gates.name: clustered interval
gates.rule: the interval resamples whole game weeks

gates.name: multiplicity
gates.rule: two or more scored strategies get a familywise correction

gates.name: control
gates.rule: a market-following control must be beaten on the same games

gates.name: volume
gates.rule: no score is published below the pre-registered sample

gates.name: demotion
gates.rule: a strategy that fails G3 in two consecutive settled windows is demoted and its score is retired, not quietly reset
gates.passes: demotion logged with the window ids

strategies.name: Model fair line vs consensus close
strategies.definition: bet the side whenever the model's fair margin differs from the de-vigged consensus by more than one point, at the price actually printed

strategies.name: Model fair total vs consensus close
strategies.definition: bet the total when the model's fair total differs from the consensus by more than one point

strategies.name: De-vigged consensus reversion
strategies.definition: bet a book whose de-vigged price is further from the two-book median than the median's own dispersion

strategies.name: Availability-adjusted re-price
strategies.blocked_reason: depth readings exist for 1 of 32 clubs, so the adjustment cannot be estimated. A fixed penalty per starter is explicitly rejected by the brief and by this desk.
strategies.definition: re-price the model only by a coefficient measured from settled games, never by a hand-set number

strategies.name: Rest and travel
strategies.definition: use only the published schedule: short week, back-to-back road games, and the international trip

strategies.name: Same-game parlay
strategies.blocked_reason: joint evidence gate: the dependence between legs must be measured on settled same-game data before any combo is priced
strategies.definition: price a two-leg combo only from a measured joint distribution, never from the product of marginals

strategies.name: Player-prop combo
strategies.blocked_reason: no licensed prop feed exists on this desk; the boards print props but the desk cannot store them under its own data policy
strategies.definition: player-level pricing requires a feed the desk is permitted to store

control_baselines.name: take the close
control_baselines.rule: price every game at the closing line
control_baselines.why: a strategy that cannot beat this is the market with extra steps

control_baselines.name: market favourite
control_baselines.rule: always take the favourite at the printed price
control_baselines.why: catches a strategy that is just following strength

control_baselines.name: home club
control_baselines.why: catches a strategy that is just a home-field tilt

control_baselines.name: singles only, shadow
control_baselines.rule: the same strategy priced as singles even when the family is combos
control_baselines.why: removes correlation and staking from the comparison

data_policy.price_source: two operator boards, read manually, hashed, with a UTC clock per capture
data_policy.nfl_data: manual reads of official pages, hashed, stored as dated snapshots, never a feed. nfl.com terms section 1.3 restricts systematic retrieval to compile a database.
data_policy.no_inference: a value that was not read stays blank and is flagged. a blank is never a zero.
data_policy.clock: every capture carries its own UTC read time, and every page states the age of the number it shows

luck_removal: familywise correction across the registered family
stake_split: the signal column (skill vs benchmark) and the staking column (units risked) are published separately and never combined into one headline number, because a good signal can be staked badly and a bad signal staked luckily
